instruction: Move all products with over 3.7 rating from my amazon wish list to cart.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The wish list is modeled with placeholder products: wl-product-1..3 stand for the entries whose product rating is over 3.7 (static fact rating-over-threshold) and wl-product-4 for the entries at or below 3.7; the real number of each kind is only known at runtime, and the plan loops the show_product/move pair once per qualifying entry. Products are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can list every goal literal in its precondition without quantified goals. amazon.show_wish_list reveals wish-list membership and quantities (wish-list-known); amazon.show_product (no token, no side effects) reveals the rating (rating-known) - if show_wish_list already returns the rating these calls can be dropped. The move action passes quantity explicitly equal to the wish-list quantity so the whole entry moves and the wish-list entry disappears, matching the evaluation which requires only CartEntry and WishListEntry to change and the qualifying product ids to be in the cart (with their full quantity) and gone from the wish list, while non-qualifying ones stay. complete_task is called with no answer.
